mapper.select: select from wvp_vlstream_firmware_task where request_id=#{requestId} limit 1
select from wvp_vlstream_firmware_task where mqtt_message_id=#{mqttMessageId} limit 1
select from wvp_vlstream_firmware_task where device_row_id=#{deviceRowId} order by create_time desc,id desc limit 1

select count(*) from wvp_vlstream_firmware_task where device_row_id=#{deviceRowId} and target=#{target} and deploy_status in ('CREATED','PUBLISHED','ACCEPTED','DOWNLOADING','VERIFYING','INSTALLING','REBOOTING')
mapper.update: update wvp_vlstream_firmware_task set deploy_status='PUBLISHED',published_at=#{publishedAt},update_time=#{publishedAt} where id=#{id} and deploy_status='CREATED'
update wvp_vlstream_firmware_task set deploy_status='FAILED',failure_reason=#{failureReason},completed_at=#{completedAt},update_time=#{completedAt} where id=#{id} and deploy_status='CREATED'

update wvp_vlstream_firmware_task set deploy_status=#{deployStatus},last_reply_at=#{lastReplyAt},completed_at=#{completedAt},failure_reason=#{failureReason},reply_payload=#{replyPayload},update_time=#{lastReplyAt} where id=#{id} and deploy_status in ('CREATED','PUBLISHED','ACCEPTED','DOWNLOADING','VERIFYING','INSTALLING','REBOOTING')

update wvp_vlstream_firmware_task set deploy_status='TIMED_OUT',completed_at=#{now},update_time=#{now},failure_reason='OTA 下载阶段超过下载地址有效期' where deploy_status in ('CREATED','PUBLISHED','ACCEPTED','DOWNLOADING') and download_expires_at < #{nowEpoch}

update wvp_vlstream_firmware_task set deploy_status='TIMED_OUT',completed_at=#{now},update_time=#{now},failure_reason='OTA 安装阶段长时间没有设备进度回执' where deploy_status in ('VERIFYING','INSTALLING','REBOOTING') and update_time < #{deadline}
